content.text: In a West End cast list like this, what does "Swing" mean? https://london.jesuschristsuperstar.com/cast-and-creative/

In West End (and Broadway) cast lists, a **Swing** is an off-stage performer who covers multiple ensemble/chorus tracks (and sometimes smaller named roles) as needed. Rather than performing every night, they're on standby to step in when a regular cast member is out sick, injured, or on holiday — so they have to learn several different tracks' blocking, choreography, and vocal parts (sometimes 4-8+ roles) rather than just one.

A few related distinctions you'll often see alongside it in a programme:
- **Standby**: covers one specific principal/named role only, usually present at every performance in case needed.
- **Understudy**: also covers one specific role, but is typically a member of the ensemble also performing their own track that night, stepping in only when required.
- **Dance Captain**: separate role — maintains choreography standards and often also swings/understudies.

So on that *Jesus Christ Superstar* cast list, anyone billed as "Swing" is part of the company ready to slot into several different ensemble tracks (and possibly cover named roles) rather than appearing in a fixed part every show.
